outcome: proportion of preterm births within 2 days
proportion of preterm births within 7 days
cohort: The study included women admitted due to preterm labor after 34 weeks of gestation who delivered in the late preterm period.
finding: The use of tocolytics significantly prolonged the time from admission to delivery and reduced the proportion of preterm births within 2 and 7 days, allowing more time for antenatal corticosteroid administration.
